# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.15 — Three-axis unified hardening

<!-- update-summary: Preview.15 unifies native/OLE, motion/material/accessibility, DropLink, clipboard/update/storage, SSOT governance, and release-contract hardening. -->

Preview.15 is the three-axis unified-hardening Preview defined by the Preview.15 development plan. It preserves the Windows 10 version 1809 (Build 17763) runtime baseline, x64 release boundary, Dynamic-Island-only ownership model, local-first storage, source-safe file references, and fail-closed Smart Drag/OLE rules.

## Native and OLE hardening

- Native region identity now includes the physical origin, dimensions, radii, DPI, and shape inputs that affect the actual HRGN. Repeated steady geometry and hidden transitions can therefore be deduplicated without treating different screen-space regions as identical.
- OLE capability classification no longer treats an ISTORAGE-only object as a materializable file. Descriptor-backed ISTREAM and HGLOBAL paths remain bounded; unsupported virtual payloads fail closed before visual authorization.
- Smart Drag state and motion deduplication share the same lifecycle boundary, and topology/monitor enqueue failures reset to a recoverable state instead of leaving a stale candidate or visual target alive.
- The visible Overlay remains the sole OLE owner while active; hidden idle remains input-free and the traditional top-edge mode remains an explicit compatibility choice.

## Motion, material, and accessibility

- Geometry, opacity, content, interaction, and elevation remain separate channels with canonical 0/83/167/250/333 ms motion tokens, wall-clock catch-up, bounded interruption, and reduced-motion behavior without bounce or outward scale.
- Layout, lifecycle, exact native geometry, and hit-region ownership stay on the UI thread. Compositor-backed work is limited to visual-only channels.
- Windows 11 Desktop Acrylic is capability- and preference-gated for the transient Island only. Windows 10, disabled effects, unsupported/failing backdrop paths, and high contrast use semantic system-aware solid resources.
- Accessibility and high-contrast states consume semantic tokens, and Smart Drag policy/capability decisions are centralized rather than duplicated in views or probes.

## DropLink and transport security

- Authentication verifies the actual buffered request body SHA-256 and binds it to HMAC validation; a claimed hash no longer authenticates an altered body.
- Pairing admission, remote-address capacity, nonce replay, session retention, completion, and finalization are bounded and observable. Completion is single-flight/idempotent, replay state is bounded/expiring, and verified transfer chunks are committed atomically without double-counting duplicates.
- Pairing and sharing cryptographic material, transient share keys, and revoke handles use bounded reads and explicit clearing. Nearby transport requires the documented private-network/security policy and presents an explicit safe fallback when its guarantees are unavailable.

## Clipboard, update, and storage boundaries

- Clipboard image capture rejects compressed-size, dimensions, pixel-count, decoded-memory, and codec-working-set budget violations before expensive decode. UI capture stays on the dispatcher while decode/validation remains bounded worker work.
- Update operations have coordinator/single-flight ownership; settings and log recovery use bounded reads/retries; SQLite schema contracts are validated before use; partial update cleanup and transient state files are recoverable and scoped.
- Release metadata, website artifact kinds, installer timing policy, protocol routes, worker constants, and hardcoding governance have explicit single-source owners.

## Verification boundary

The hosted Windows CI and release workflow are the publication gate for compilation, policy tests, App/native-boundary tests, packaging, installer lifecycle, portable smoke, localized resources, hardcoding governance, and website/release contracts. This Preview remains **CONDITIONAL** for real Windows 10/11 OS/DPI/multi-monitor/OLE/accessibility/performance interaction, real two-device DropLink transfer, Nearby behavior, and operator-deployed Worker/browser acceptance. Those rows require attached evidence from matching real targets and are never inferred from hosted CI or source inspection.

## 中文说明

- Preview.15 把原生/OLE、动效/材质/无障碍、DropLink 与剪贴板/更新/存储三条加固轴统一到同一组可验证契约中。
- 请求体哈希认证、配对准入、重放缓存、单飞完成、原子分块提交和密钥边界已收紧。
- 发布、网站 artifact kind、安装器时序、路由、Worker 常量、动效和 Smart Drag 策略均由单一来源治理。
- 真机 Windows、双设备传输与 Worker/浏览器验收仍必须提供实际目标证据；本 Preview 不把托管 CI 当作真机证据。
